sq3_allelic_distribution.summary: No published study has directly characterized the allelic distribution (monoallelic vs biallelic vs LOH-assisted) of BRCA1 constitutional methylation in TNBC patients.

closest_papers.citation: Van Heetvelde M et al. Cancer Lett. 2018 Jul 1;425:125-133.
closest_papers.title: Accurate detection and quantification of epigenetic and genetic second hits in BRCA1 and BRCA2-associated hereditary breast and ovarian cancer
closest_papers.relevance: Addresses second hits in germline BRCA1 mutation carriers — a related but distinct population. Provides methodological precedent for detecting co-acting epigenetic + genetic second hits via allele-specific assays.
closest_papers.population_note: Germline BRCA1 mutation carriers (not constitutional methylation carriers); epigenetic silencing is the second hit here, not the primary event

closest_papers.citation: Maxwell KN et al. Nat Commun. 2017 Aug 22;8(1):319.
closest_papers.title: BRCA locus-specific loss of heterozygosity in germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 carriers
closest_papers.relevance: LOH frequency and patterns in germline carriers. Establishes that LOH rates vary by tumor type and BRCA1 vs BRCA2. Provides background for estimating LOH-assisted silencing probability in methylation carriers.
closest_papers.key_finding: LOH at BRCA1 locus highly penetrant in triple-negative breast tumors from germline carriers — supports LOH + monoallelic methylation as viable biallelic silencing pathway

sq3_allelic_distribution.critical_gap: No ASBP (allele-specific bisulfite pyrosequencing) or equivalent assay has been applied to the constitutional methylation carrier population to determine what fraction achieve biallelic silencing. The Institut Curie n=136 cohort (PMID 41654537) used standard MSP and did not report allelic stratification.

estimated_allelic_distribution.method: Extrapolation from ovarian cancer data (Geisler 2002, PMID 11773283) + BRCA1 LOH frequency in TNBC from Maxwell 2017
estimated_allelic_distribution.monoallelic_methylation_plus_LOH: ~40-50% of methylation carriers (LOH highly penetrant in TNBC per Maxwell 2017)
estimated_allelic_distribution.confidence: LOW — these are extrapolated estimates, not measured values
estimated_allelic_distribution.note: If LOH-assisted cases are counted, total biallelic silencing may be 65-80% of the 20.6% — validating the hypothesis's eligibility expansion claim for a substantial subpopulation

sq4_rad51_treatment_naive.summary: No published study has applied pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay specifically to constitutional BRCA1 methylation carriers in treatment-naive TNBC. This is the critical unexplored gap.

existing_evidence.finding: HR reactivation (RAD51 foci positive) occurs post-NACT in BRCA1-methylated TNBC — poor olaparib responders
existing_evidence.gap: Does NOT address treatment-naive methylation carriers; HR status pre-chemotherapy unknown

existing_evidence.citation: AlHilli MM et al. Gynecol Oncol. 2016 Nov;143(2):379-388.
existing_evidence.finding: RAD51 foci formation after DNA damage correlated with niraparib resistance in HRD-proficient vs HRD-deficient ovarian cancer models
existing_evidence.relevance: Establishes RAD51 foci assay as predictive of PARPi response in HR-deficient cancer — cross-cancer precedent for TNBC application
existing_evidence.gap: PDX models, not human treatment-naive primary tumors; different cancer type

cross_cancer_precedent.finding: RAD51-negative tumors (HR-deficient by foci assay) had 3-4x higher PARPi benefit vs RAD51-positive
cross_cancer_precedent.transferability: Supports the concept that pre-treatment RAD51 foci can stratify PARPi benefit; needs validation in BRCA1-methylated TNBC specifically

sq4_rad51_treatment_naive.gap_specificity: The intersection of (1) pre-treatment timing + (2) BRCA1 constitutional methylation + (3) breast cancer = ZERO published studies. All existing RAD51 foci PARPi data is post-NACT (Velazquez) or HGSOC (PAOLA-1) or in vitro/PDX.

sample_size_estimate.rationale: Power calculation for pre-treatment RAD51 foci assay as PARPi response predictor in BRCA1-methylated TNBC
assumptions: Expected effect size: RAD51-negative (foci<10% S-phase cells) predicts PARPi ORR ~45% vs RAD51-positive predicts ORR ~10% (extrapolated from PAOLA-1 HR)
Expected biallelic fraction: ~65-80% of methylation carriers
sample_size_estimate.feasibility_note: Institut Curie TNBC biobank (~300+ samples per year) could achieve accrual in 18-24 months with retrospective archival tumor biopsies if paired blood available

verdict_rationale: Both SQ-3 (allelic distribution) and SQ-4 (treatment-naive RAD51 foci) confirmed as unexplored. The literature exhaustion supports the hypothesis's novelty claim. The allelic distribution extrapolation suggests 65-80% of the 20.6% TNBC constitutional methylation carriers likely achieve biallelic silencing (methylation + LOH), making the eligible population ~13-16% of TNBC — a clinically meaningful number. The pre-treatment RAD51 assay gap is the specific experimental contribution the hypothesis would make.
impact_on_hypothesis: STRENGTHENS hyp-tnbc-001-v2-refined. The absence of allelic distribution data and treatment-naive RAD51 data are NOT weaknesses that contradict the hypothesis — they confirm that the required experiments have not been done, validating the novelty claim.
recommended_next_node: SQ-4 → design pre-treatment RAD51 foci study protocol (EXP-20260331-004): n=388 TNBC screen, collect pre-treatment core biopsy, RAD51 foci by S-phase-restricted IF, biallelic methylation confirmed by ASBP

composite_score_update.evidential_quality_update: +0.03 (both gaps confirmed, cross-cancer RAD51 precedent stronger than expected)
